zh-CN.title: 拍求婚，什么时候把镜头转给朋友
zh-CN.dek: 20:55 到 20:59 这四分钟里，上海宝格丽的私密餐叙从起身敬酒走到满桌举杯，主角看不到的那半圈表情都在亲友手里。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 求婚那一刻主角只看得见眼前人，所以他们最容易错过背后整桌朋友举杯和偷偷摸出手机的那几秒。

en.title: When to Turn the Camera Toward the Friends
en.dek: Across four minutes at Bvlgari in Shanghai, the gathering moved from a quiet stand-up toast to a full-table cheer—and half the story happened where the couple couldn't see it.
en.pull_quote: During a proposal, the couple only sees each other—so the friends raising phones and glasses behind them are half of what you're there to preserve.

zh-CN.text: 20:55 那一下，他刚端着红酒杯起身，对面桌的朋友已经笑出了声。拍私密求婚，核心时刻当然要最先保住，但事后最容易让两位主角反复回看的，往往是他们当时背对着、来不及顾及的那一圈亲友反应。

en.text: At 20:55, the moment he stood up holding a glass of red wine, laughter was already spreading down the table. Locking the main proposal moment always comes first, yet the frames couples return to most afterward are often the reactions happening just behind their backs.

zh-CN.text: 四分钟后的起哄，不打闪才留得住松弛

en.text: Keeping Ambient Warmth for Unfiltered Reactions

zh-CN.text: 20:59 这张我保持纯环境光，把感光度推到 ISO 6400、快门压在 1/60s、焦段收在 35mm。木墙上的黑白肖像挂画、肩后露出一角的白纸花束，和身旁朋友手里攥着手机忍不住看过来偷笑的神情，都在暗暖的灯光里自然落下来，没有被闪光灯打散气氛。

en.text: Four minutes later at 20:59, I stayed completely in ambient light at 35mm, 1/60s, and ISO 6400. The warm wood paneling, monochrome wall prints, white bouquet edge tucked behind his shoulder, and the friend holding her phone while watching him lean back for a forkful all stay intact because no flash interrupted the joke.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 16-35/F4 · 35mm · 1/60s · f/4 · ISO 6400 · 20:59

zh-CN.caption: 20:59 纯环境光下抓到的轻松一幕，身旁朋友举着手机笑着望向斜后仰吃点心的他，白色花束在身后露出一角。

en.caption: Caught at 20:59 in ISO 6400 ambient tungsten light, a friend holds her phone smiling as he leans back playfully beside the wrapped bouquet.

zh-CN.text: 切回 16mm 整桌画面，人情关系才有坐标

en.text: Stepping Back to 16mm So Every Seat Has Context

zh-CN.text: 只拍局部特写，几年后翻相册很难想起那天到底坐了多少人、谁挨着谁。20:57 大家齐齐举杯时，我换回 16mm 超广端，降到 ISO 100 补进一次干净的闪光，把左侧玻璃门上的 BVLGARI 字样、头顶编织吊灯、桌前冰桶和十四位亲友的笑脸一次性收稳。

en.text: Close-ups alone don't tell you who sat next to whom once the night passes. When the whole table raised their glasses at 20:57, I pulled back to 16mm at ISO 100 with a clean flash pop—bringing in the etched BVLGARI glass door on the left, the woven pendant lamp overhead, the champagne bucket, and all fourteen guests in one crisp frame.

zh-CN.text: 这里顺便给求婚策划和朋友群一个实际建议：十几个人围坐卡座时，桌尾或中轴一定要提前留出半米走道。正是因为中间那条通道没被椅子堵死，我才能在两分钟内顺畅退到 16mm 拍完大合照，再贴近桌面抓反应。

en.text: For planners and friends organizing a dinner surprise, leaving even two feet of clearance at the foot of parallel tables makes all the difference. Because that narrow lane stayed clear of extra stools, I could drop back to 16mm for the group toast and glide forward again without squeezing past guests.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 16-35/F4 · 16mm · 1/60s · f/4 · ISO 100 · 20:57

zh-CN.caption: 20:57 用 16mm 广角与补光收下满桌举杯同框，左侧玻璃上的 BVLGARI 字样与头顶藤编吊灯清楚交代出房间格局。

en.caption: At 20:57, 16mm with ISO 100 flash frames the entire toast—showing the etched BVLGARI door on the left, woven pendant lamp, and all fourteen friends.

zh-CN.text: 用 1/40s 接住刚起身那股热气

en.text: Holding 1/40s When the Room First Shifts

zh-CN.text: 回到整段高潮起头的 20:55，我手里是 24-105mm 镜头的 41mm 端，参数停在 1/40s、f/4、ISO 6400。他左手攥着手机、右手举起红酒杯刚站直，旁边穿灰西装外套配粉裙的女主角笑着仰头回敬，藤编灯暖黄的光圈正正打在他们肩头。整组片子交回给两个人时，近景的热度和 16mm 满桌的坐标互为注解。

en.text: Tracing back to 20:55 when that four-minute sequence opened, I was on the 24-105mm at 41mm, 1/40s, f/4, and ISO 6400. Standing up with his phone still tucked in his left hand while raising a wine glass in his right, he drew an immediate smile as she lifted hers under the woven pendant glow. Paired with the 16mm table frame, those ambient shots keep both the emotion and the room intact.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 41mm · 1/40s · f/4 · ISO 6400 · 20:55

zh-CN.caption: 20:55 刚起身敬酒的一瞬，41mm 搭配 1/40s 保留了藤编吊灯洒在木墙上的暖光，以及身旁伴侣抬杯的笑容。

en.caption: At 20:55, 41mm and 1/40s at ISO 6400 preserve the warm wicker-lamp glow across the wood wall as he stands to toast beside her.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
提前确认求婚主角面向与站位，留出能斜向同时带到朋友桌面反应的机位走廊
备妥广角大合影闪光方案与高感纯环境光抓拍两套节奏，不让连续闪光破坏包间私密感
在起身、拥抱或起哄瞬间先保主角动作，紧接着多留三秒扫拍同桌举手机和笑声
提醒亲友桌尾预留至少半米通道，避免餐椅挤死导致 16mm 全景无法退步拍摄

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Map the couple's facing direction beforehand so you hold a clean lane toward friends' reactions
Keep both an ambient high-ISO setting for candid mood and a single wide flash setup for full-table toasts
Lock the couple's decisive action first, then linger three beats on guests raising phones and glasses
Ask planners to leave a clear two-foot gap at the table end so wide-angle group frames don't get boxed in

zh-CN.title: 十岁生日，合照、蛋糕和窗外夜景怎么兼顾
zh-CN.dek: 在高空江景包间办十岁生日宴，窗外楼宇灯光、蛋糕前的照料动作和一张干净的个人肖像，得各自留好位子。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 十年后再翻这晚的照片，最动人的往往不是大声喊出来的“看镜头”，而是切蛋糕前家长低头替孩子系好帽带的那三秒。

en.title: Balancing Family Frames, Cake Prep, and Night Views at Ten
en.dek: At a tenth birthday overlooking the night skyline, keeping the skyline arch, unscripted cake-table moments, and a clean solo frame meant guarding pace in the schedule.
en.pull_quote: Years later, the frame a family lingers on isn't everyone shouting cheese—it's the three quiet seconds when a parent ties on the birthday hat before the cake.

zh-CN.text: 落地玻璃外是整片夜色摩天楼，屋里红底花鸟墙前立着银色大气球。十岁生日宴布置一满，最容易犯的错就是凑太近拍大头照，把家长专门定下的高空夜景和整套白色弧形迎宾背景一起裁没了。

en.text: Floor-to-ceiling glass opened straight onto the illuminated skyline towers right next to red wallpaper and silver "10" balloons. When a room carries that much visual detail, stepping in too close crops out both the night skyline and the welcome arch the family spent weeks putting together.

zh-CN.text: 往后退半步，让夜色和迎宾板同框

en.text: Stepping Back to Hold Both the Welcome Arch and Skyline

zh-CN.text: 和孩子妈妈在「10th Birthday Party」白色弧形迎宾板前留合影时，我刻意退到餐椅边缘往横构图收。母子俩穿同色系灰色马甲和连衣裙配小领结比着剪刀手，左侧弧形字牌、花艺底座和右侧整片玻璃窗外的城市大厦刚好各占一半画面，而且人物位置足够靠前，室内补光不会在玻璃上打出一团刺眼白斑。

en.text: Standing with the mother and boy beside the curved "10th Birthday Party" welcome board, I stepped back to the dining chairs so the horizontal frame held both the floral arch and the city towers beyond the glass. Wearing matching grey outfits with bow ties, they stood far enough forward from the window that interior light kept their faces crisp without blowing reflections across the skyline.

zh-CN.caption: 身穿灰西装马甲配领结的寿星与妈妈在弧形生日牌前比耶合影，右侧整面落地窗映出陆家嘴夜晚大厦灯光。

en.caption: In matching grey outfits and bow ties, the birthday boy and his mother flash V-signs beside the welcome arch as the night skyline glows through the window.

zh-CN.text: 蛋糕刚上桌，别急着催孩子笑

en.text: Waiting Through Cake Prep Instead of Forcing a Pose

zh-CN.text: 写着「十岁啦」的水果奶油蛋糕摆上桌后，大人通常会忙着喊“看镜头”。我反而最留意戴帽子的这几秒：妈妈弯身低头把蓝灰气球皇冠帽的丝带在下巴底下系好，十岁的男生略微仰着下巴乖乖配合，旁边黄衣长辈安静坐在一旁看过来。这种手忙脚乱里的一点温柔，没法靠重拍补出来，只要家长别把每一秒都切碎去摆拍，镜头自然能接着。

en.text: Once the fruit-and-cream cake with its tenth-birthday plaque reached the table, everyone's impulse is to call for eyes forward. Instead, I stayed ready during the brief prep: the mother leaned in to tie the ribbon of a blue-and-grey balloon crown beneath his chin while an older relative watched quietly from beside the teapot. Giving families three unhurried beats here preserves caretaking that posed group shots miss.

zh-CN.caption: 十岁生日水果蛋糕刚摆好，妈妈低头替男孩系上蓝灰气球皇冠帽带，右侧黄衣长辈静静坐在茶壶旁相伴。

en.caption: Behind the birthday cake, the mother adjusts the ribbon of a balloon crown under the boy's chin while a family elder sits quietly beside the teapot.

zh-CN.text: 开席前趁地面还整洁，留一张干净的十岁单人照

en.text: Capturing One Clean Solo Portrait Before Dinner Begins

zh-CN.text: 孩子到了十岁，往往既想保有大男孩的体面，又还是会喜欢手里的小猿猴气球花束。开宴前趁伴手礼纸袋还整齐排在绿植花槽前、桌椅没被挪乱，我单拍了一张直立竖构图：灰西装三件套配球鞋，脚边一排森林动物手提袋，以后哪怕从整本相册里单独抽出来装框，也一眼认得出是十岁这天。

en.text: At ten, kids sit right between grown-up suits and playful balloon bouquets. Before guests unpacked the favors and pushed chairs out of line, I carved out two minutes for a clean vertical solo portrait: grey vest suit and sneakers, holding his monkey-balloon bouquet above a neat row of woodland gift bags so the frame stands firmly on its own in a print frame.

zh-CN.caption: 穿灰西装套配球鞋的十岁男孩站在生日牌前手捧小猴气球花束，脚边整齐排列着森林动物主题伴手礼袋。

en.caption: Standing solo before the welcome arch, the ten-year-old holds a wrapped monkey-balloon bouquet above neatly arranged woodland-animal favor bags.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
落地窗夜景包间拍合影时，避开玻璃正对闪光角度，同时留出迎宾字牌与窗外楼景的横幅比例
开席前趁伴手礼袋和花艺最整洁时，先花两分钟拍完孩子单人正装竖版肖像
吹蜡烛和戴生日帽前提醒亲友不必一直看镜头，保留长辈弯腰照料的自然瞬间
把单人肖像、亲友合影与蛋糕互动按环节排序交付，方便家长直接挑图做十岁纪念册

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Angle window-side portraits away from direct glass reflection so both the welcome arch and city skyline stay crisp
Shoot the child's solo vertical portrait before dinner while favor bags and floral displays are still tidy
Ask relatives not to interrupt cake prep with constant camera cues so quiet caretaking moments stay intact
Sequence solo portraits, family groupings, and cake moments clearly so parents can build a tenth-birthday album easily

zh-CN.title: 婚车边上，别急着把画面收紧
zh-CN.dek: 上海中环的婚礼跟拍，雨棚下的吻、车门敞开时的弯腰叮嘱，和落窗后车里的回望，靠的都是多留半步距离。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 车门打开的那十秒，亲友不会配合摄影师重演一遍；你只要站在能同时看清车里与车外的位置等住。

en.title: Leave Breathing Room Beside the Wedding Car
en.dek: During a wedding arrival in Shanghai's Zhonghuan area, a kiss beneath the canopy, a bent-in blessing at the open door, and a quiet glance through the window all relied on not crowding the car.
en.pull_quote: In the ten seconds a car door swings open, relatives won't repeat their goodbye for the camera—you just have to hold the angle that keeps both faces clear.

zh-CN.text: 黑色婚车刚停稳在雨棚下，很多人本能就会往前抢两步拍大特写。我却故意往后收了半步，把黑色车门、金属轮毂和垂在身侧的粉白玫瑰捧花一起留进画面——空间和车体留住了，两个人靠在一起的重心才稳。

en.text: When the black wedding car stopped under the gridded canopy, the easy reflex is to step right in for a tight close-up. I held half a step back instead so the wheel, dark car flank, and pink-and-white bouquet anchored how close the couple stood.

zh-CN.text: 用车身和捧花，给亲密留出依托

en.text: Anchoring the Couple With the Car and Bouquet

zh-CN.text: 穿蕾丝无袖婚纱的新娘右手自然垂落提着粉白玫瑰，左手轻按在腰间露出婚戒；穿灰西装、粉领带的新郎单手插兜俯身吻过来，头顶深色方格雨棚压住天光，避免逆光冲淡白纱纹理。多留出的这点车身比例，不会把捧花切在手腕处，也能让站姿看起来舒展自然。

en.text: In her sleeveless lace gown, the bride holds her ribbon-tied pink-and-white rose bouquet loosely at her side with one hand resting lightly over her waist; the groom in a grey suit and pale pink tie leans in with one hand relaxed in his pocket. Overhead, the dark canopy keeps harsh sky glare off the lace, while that extra half-step spares the bouquet from getting sliced at the wrist.

zh-CN.caption: 雨棚网格阴影下，新人在黑色婚车前倾身相吻，新娘右手垂持粉白玫瑰捧花、左手轻覆腰间婚纱蕾丝。

en.caption: Under the gridded canopy, the couple kisses beside the black wedding car while her pink-and-white rose bouquet hangs cleanly beside the front wheel.

zh-CN.text: 车门一开，站在门框外等那个弯腰的瞬间

en.text: Waiting Outside the Open Door for Unscripted Goodbyes

zh-CN.text: 后排车门敞开时，现场往往最忙乱。但只要不急着请旁人让开，就常能遇上最动人的一幕：一位穿粉色珠绣裙、戴珍珠项链的女长辈弯身探进车门，一手扶在女儿肩头、一手轻托脸庞叮嘱，虚化的捧花正好隔在两人中间。对新人和婚礼督导来说，上下车前别把流程卡得太死，留出几十秒自由告别，往往能换来整天最难重演的一格画面。

en.text: When the rear passenger door swings open, coordinators often rush to clear the doorway for clean shots. Leaving that space unhurried lets real moments breathe: an older woman in a beaded blush-pink dress and pearls leans into the car, holding the bride's shoulder and gently touching her cheek as the bouquet blurs softly between them. Give families those thirty unscheduled seconds before closing the door.

zh-CN.caption: 后车门敞开时，穿粉色珠绣连衣裙的女长辈俯身探进车厢轻抚新娘脸颊与肩头，车内新娘仰头微笑望向长辈。

en.caption: Through the open rear car door, a female elder in a beaded blush dress leans down to hold the bride's shoulder and cheek as she smiles up from the seat.

zh-CN.text: 降下车窗后，把杂乱留在门框外

en.text: Using the Lowered Car Window as a Quiet Frame

zh-CN.text: 车门合上、车窗摇下来以后，节奏立刻静了一半。我把镜头稍微压低，让镀铬门把手上的粉花丝带留在左下角，漆面映着行道树的绿影，新郎安静退在暗处副驾一侧，新娘手搭在窗沿上往外轻看一眼。前面有车身与长辈互动交代了热闹，这里就该安静地把目光留给新娘。

en.text: Once the door shuts and the rear window slides down, the noise drops by half. Lowering my angle slightly keeps the pink ribbon on the chrome door handle at lower left, reflects green street trees across the black paint, lets the groom sit quietly shaded in the background, and frames the bride resting her fingers along the sill in one composed closing beat.

zh-CN.caption: 从车外隔着降下的后车窗拍新娘，手搭窗沿微笑回望镜头，左下角门把手系着粉色丝带花饰。

en.caption: Framed through the lowered rear window, the bride rests her fingers on the sill with a calm smile above the ribbon-tied chrome door handle.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
婚车刚停稳时先退半步，保留轮毂、车身线条与捧花完整高度，不急于切大头近景
上下车前与督导沟通留出三十秒缓冲，别过早把凑到门边叮嘱的父母亲友清离画面
站位选择在打开的车门斜外侧，确保车内新娘与车外弯腰长辈双方脸部都不被门框遮挡
发车前请新娘降下一半后车窗，利用黑色门板树影与窗框快速收一张干净肖像

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Step back half a pace beside the parked car first so wheels, door lines, and full bouquet stay intact
Ask wedding coordinators for a 30-second buffer at the open door before clearing family away
Hold an exterior angle slightly off the open door hinge so both the seated bride and leaning relative stay visible
Have the rear window lowered halfway right before departure for one calm framed portrait

zh-CN.title: 小团队怎么接案：开机前先问一句，照片拍完拿去哪里用
zh-CN.dek: 从花小念的花艺品牌肖像到中船动力临港基地揭牌，RFG Studio 保持精简编制，是为了把沟通链路直接压回真实用途上。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 摄影师最容易在现场自嗨，但客户真正买单的是回去能直接落版、能按环节找到图、不用再二次返工的成片。

en.title: Small by Design: Asking Where the Photographs Live Before Pressing Record
en.dek: From Huaxiaonian floral brand portraits to CSSC Power’s corporate unveiling in Shanghai, keeping RFG Studio lean cuts out agency telephone games and aligns every frame to real use.
en.pull_quote: It’s easy to chase favourite frames on set; what clients actually need is an edit sorted so an editor can pull the right unveiling or brand image in ten seconds.

zh-CN.text: 品牌调性拍摄：人坐进花艺里，还要留出自己的辨识度

en.text: Brand Portraits: Putting a Person Beside the Flowers Without Losing Identity

zh-CN.text: 客户约拍摄时最常漏掉的一句话，就是这批照片下周到底放进哪个版面。拍「花小念」花艺形象时，粉玫瑰、绣球、蝴蝶兰与染色棕榈叶堆起的大花盒放在浅粉色护墙板前，花本身已经够抢眼，难点是把人放进去以后还能看出品牌脾气。这张竖构图我让模特穿浅蓝牛仔套装、深灰棒球帽和薄荷绿运动鞋，随性坐在大理石矮圆桌沿上——一点微冷的牛仔色刚好压住满屋暖粉和人字木地板，2:3 竖幅上下留白也能直接适配社媒封面。

en.text: The single detail clients most often leave off a brief is where those photographs will actually live next week. On the Huaxiaonian floral brand shoot, the oversized hatbox arrangement of roses, hydrangeas, orchids, and tinted palm fans against blush wainscoting was already rich in colour—the real question was giving the brand character once a person entered the frame. Seating the subject casually on the marble side table in faded blue denim, a charcoal cap, and mint sneakers adds a cool counterweight while the 2:3 vertical frame leaves ready space for mobile headers.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念花艺竖构图肖像：浅水洗牛仔服饰在暖粉护墙板与大型花艺旁形成冷暖平衡，兼顾品牌社媒版式。

en.caption: For Huaxiaonian, faded denim balances the warm blush paneling and overflowing floral box while keeping clean vertical cover margins.

zh-CN.text: 工业企业活动：别按个人喜好排图，按议程环节归档

en.text: Industrial Briefs: Sort by Agenda Stage, Not Personal Favourites

zh-CN.text: 换到「中船动力（集团）有限公司」企业活动，交片逻辑完全反过来。2026 年 3 月 30 日临港基地揭牌这一场，后续揭牌、研发室技术参观、培训和合影可能要分给不同部门写新闻或归档。如果摄影师只顾着把气氛照排前面，公关找一张端正揭牌图还得翻半天。因此红绸拉开那一刻，我宁可收点景深，把铜牌上的“上海质量技术监督教育培训中心 临港基地 CSSC”以及背后蓝屏日期全部留实，连右下角拿手机同步录影的嘉宾都成了现场佐证。

en.text: Turn to CSSC Power (Group) Co., Ltd., and the editing logic flips completely. At the March 30, 2026 Lingang base unveiling, separate teams needed distinct assets for news releases, lab tours, training recaps, and company archives. Burying a straightforward unveiling shot behind moody favourites slows everyone down. When the red silk came off the wooden easel, stopping down kept the brass plaque lettering and digital screen date tack-sharp—and the guest recording on a smartphone at bottom right adds instant documentary proof.

zh-CN.caption: 2026 年 3 月 30 日中船动力临港基地揭牌现场：红绸拉开瞬间兼顾铜牌字样、大屏日期与嘉宾拍摄视角。

en.caption: On March 30, 2026 at CSSC Power’s Lingang unveiling, the red silk pull keeps the brass plaque, date screen, and guest phone crisp.

zh-CN.text: 为什么保持小团队直连：少一层传话，少一次返工

en.text: Why We Stay Lean: One Direct Line Instead of Agency Telephone

zh-CN.text: 走进 105 设备研发室时，嘉宾们正围在黑色实验台前看那台紫色“CPGC 氨逃逸分析仪”。蓝色大门上的房间铭牌与主讲人扶着仪器的手势都留清楚，别人一眼就知道事情发生在哪儿。RFG Studio 由奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司运营，我们刻意不设层层转包与传话客服：开拍前直接和客户确认横竖比例、新闻快修节点与合规开票需求，交付时按“揭牌 / 研发参观 / 合影”分文件夹打包，甲方打开链接就能直接取用。

en.text: Inside Room 105, Equipment Research and Development, visitors gathered around a portable CPGC Ammonia Slip Analyzer on the lab bench—keeping the doorway plaque and the presenter’s hand on the unit readable anchors where the technical tour took place. Operated via Yi Yaoxu (Shanghai) Media Technology Co., Ltd., RFG Studio keeps direct producer-to-client contact with zero agency middlemen: aspect ratios, press turnaround, and corporate invoicing are locked before arrival, and files land in labeled folders ready to publish.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力 105 设备研发室内，主讲人手扶“CPGC 氨逃逸分析仪”向到访嘉宾讲解，蓝门门牌清晰可辨。

en.caption: Inside Room 105 at CSSC Power, a presenter rests one hand on the CPGC Ammonia Slip Analyzer while briefing visiting guests.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
开机前向客户问清成片落点：新闻通稿横图、竖版社媒封面，还是内部档案留存
企业活动交片严格按“揭牌 / 培训 / 参观 / 合影”分文件夹归档，方便不同部门各取所需
揭牌铜牌、大屏日期、实验仪器型号和房间门牌在现场就收实焦距与景深
通过奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司直连确认需求与开票，避免多层转包信息失真

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Ask before shoot day whether frames go to horizontal press releases, vertical social covers, or internal records
Sort corporate galleries strictly by event stage—unveiling, training, lab tour, group shot—instead of personal favorites
Stop down on plaques, date screens, equipment labels, and room signs so key text stays legible
Lock folder structure, press deadlines, and corporate invoicing directly through Yi Yaoxu (Shanghai) Media Technology Co., Ltd.

zh-CN.title: 拍活动，别只盯着正在示范的人
zh-CN.dek: 梗犬美容和戏剧练习给了我同一个提醒。拍完一个动作，往旁边看一眼。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 工作坊里真正决定画面有没有信息量的，常常不是操作台正中间，而是半米外那些凑近的眼神和举起的手机。

en.title: Look beyond the person giving the demonstration
en.dek: A terrier grooming demonstration and a drama exercise gave me the same reminder. After photographing an action, look beside it.
en.pull_quote: In a workshop, what gives a frame its weight isn’t always at the center of the table—it’s the leaning shoulders, raised phones, and listening faces half a meter beside it.

zh-CN.text: 操作台一围上十来位学员和一排举起来的手机，站着不动根本没法拍。

en.text: Once over a dozen trainees and a ring of raised phones closed around the grooming table, staying locked on the middle would miss half the story.

zh-CN.text: 做沙龙或体验工作坊时，摄影师的眼睛太容易被正中间的老师吸住。可回到传播现场看图，真正说明“这场活动为什么好、大家学到了什么”的，往往是示范者手边半米之外的目光、身体前倾和互相回应。拍完主动作，记得往旁边扫半圈。

en.text: At live workshops and demonstrations, a camera naturally gravitates toward the person running the table. Yet when the client opens the final gallery, what proves the session worked is usually happening half a meter to the side—leaning shoulders, focused eyes, and how participants react to one another.

zh-CN.text: 先拍围观的人怎么凑近，才看得懂示范的分量

en.text: Show how the room presses in before zooming onto the table

zh-CN.text: 那场梗犬宠物美容沙龙，我先贴在人群外沿找了一个既看得到老师托住犬头的动作、又能带进一圈学员的位置。画面里穿着棕色皮围裙、口袋别着绿柄针梳的学员，连同举着云台、手机往前探头的神态全装在一起。这一张一立住，后面看懂这群人为什么屏住呼吸聚在桌边，就不必靠文字渲染。

en.text: At the Terrier Grooming Salon, I found a seam along the outer ring where the instructor’s hands steadying the terrier’s head sat surrounded by trainees in brown leather aprons—even a green slicker brush tucked into a pocket—and at least six phones tilted toward the table. That single frame shows where the whole room’s attention is concentrated without adding a word of hype.

zh-CN.caption: 梗犬美容沙龙现场，穿棕色皮围裙的学员围在操作台四周举手机记录老师托住犬头的示范动作。

en.caption: Trainees in brown leather aprons pressing around the grooming table with raised phones as the instructor steadies the terrier.

zh-CN.text: 近景等手和狗的状态接上线，才不是单纯拍一把工具

en.text: Waiting for hands and subject to align in the vertical close-up

zh-CN.text: 近距离拍实操反而最考验耐心。橙色防滑垫上落满刚拔下的浅棕色毛发，老师傅低头倾身，一手稳稳托起梗犬下颌，另一手拿着木柄拔毛刀贴着颈部顺势理毛，背景里还隐约挂着几枚比赛花结。工具一抬起就急着按，只能拍到手里拿了件铁片；等到双手力道和犬只昂头的配合刚好稳住，技术质感自然出来了。

en.text: Working close up calls for restraint. On a bright orange mat scattered with stripped tan coat hair, the groomer leaned in to hold the terrier’s muzzle gently while guiding a stripping knife cleanly along the neck, competition rosettes hanging softly behind him. Fire the shutter the second a hand lifts and you only show a tool; wait until both hands and the dog’s poise lock together and the craft reads immediately.

zh-CN.caption: 竖幅近景记录美容师俯身用一只手托住梗犬吻部、另一手沿颈侧操作拔毛刀，橙色垫面留有修剪下的毛发。

en.caption: Vertical close-up of a groomer steadying the terrier’s muzzle while working a stripping tool cleanly along its neck over the orange table mat.

zh-CN.text: 在戏剧练习里，把“说的人”和“听的人”同时留进框

en.text: Keeping both speaker and listener visible in the drama workshop

zh-CN.text: 同样的方法放在一尺花园的戏剧疗愈活动里也成立。摄影师不必也不该替参与者做任何心理判断或下结论，我们要做的是把看得见的身体回应留清楚：蓝紫发色的引导者背手站立专注聆听，戴草帽和穿条纹针织衫的两位参与者面对面摊手交谈，身后站着的同行者和木桌花材保持着安静呼吸。对话一旦同时框住发出与承接，活动气场自己就站稳了。

en.text: The same rule held at the Yichi Garden drama-therapy workshop in Shanghai. Rather than inventing psychological interpretations or claims about outcomes, the camera stays anchored to visible exchange: a violet-haired facilitator listening with hands behind her back while two participants—one in a ribboned straw hat, one in navy-and-white stripes—trade words and hand gestures face-to-face, with quiet observers and studio flowers behind them.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园戏剧疗愈工作坊中三位参与者面对面交谈与倾听，后台学员与花艺桌台构成自然环境层次。

en.caption: Three participants exchanging gestures and listening face-to-face at the Yichi Garden drama workshop, backed by seated observers and studio tables.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
教学或体验类活动先站人群外圈拍一张“大家怎么围观”，再切近景拍具体手法。
实操特写等工具、双手与操作对象动作接稳后再按快门，避免只拍到孤立器械。
互动练习尽量把“表达者”和“倾听者”放在同一张里，少拍只有单人正脸的摆拍。
现场尽量不打闪光灯或侵入操作台半米以内，让学员举手机记录与自然交流不受打断。

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Establish the ring of observers—aprons, phones, and leaning posture—before tightening onto craft details.
Hold close-up shutter timing until hands, tool, and subject align cleanly rather than shooting isolated gear.
Frame interactive exercises as two- or three-person exchanges capturing both gesture and attentive listening.
Work without intrusive flash inside tight workshop circles so participants stay focused on the session rather than the camera.

zh-CN.title: 同一台 S5II 进三种现场，我上机先看什么
zh-CN.dek: 书院民宿拍空间、滴水湖晨跑追人像、宝格丽露台拍求婚整桌——机器还是那台松下 S5II，真正决定镜头和机位的，是每场最容易漏掉的那件事。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 器材清单不是照着参数表搬进背包，而是先问清楚这一场一旦失手，客户和主角最补不回来的是哪一环。

en.title: Three Shoots on One S5II: What I Check Before Setting Any Dial
en.dek: A guesthouse room, a dawn lakeside run, and a fourteen-guest terrace proposal—same Lumix S5II, completely different first priorities.
en.pull_quote: What goes into the camera bag isn’t built from spec sheets; it starts with whichever detail would be hardest to recover if missed on that job.

zh-CN.text: 民宿客房先看比例：脚站对了再开 24mm

en.text: In a Guest Room, Fix Proportions With Your Feet Before Using 24mm

zh-CN.text: 进书院民宿拍客房，我拿起 S5II 先看的不是广角有多宽。下午三点四十二分站进这间屋，浴缸贴着落地窗，床尾紧挨左侧，右侧黑色皮沙发和落地灯靠在墙边——如果为了塞进更多墙壁往前一凑，前景浴缸会瞬间胀大，旁边的皮椅也容易被挤出画外。等床角、浴缸、窗外树影与沙发在取景器里的大小接近人眼感受，再把 24–105mm 稳在 24mm、f/5、1/250s、ISO 100 按下快门，住客看图订房才不会产生落差。

en.text: Stepping into Shuyuan Guesthouse at 15:42 with the S5II, my first check isn’t how wide the lens goes. The freestanding white tub hugs the corner glass, the bed edge anchors the left, and the black tufted bench and floor lamp sit along the right wall. Lean too close and the tub balloons while pushing the bench out of frame; only after the room’s balance matched what I saw standing there did I lock 24mm at 1/250s, f/5, and ISO 100.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 24mm · 1/250s · f/5 · ISO 100 · 15:42

zh-CN.caption: 15:42 在书院民宿客房以 24mm 收进床尾、浴缸、窗景与右侧沙发，先对齐空间尺度再定构图。

en.caption: At 15:42 inside Shuyuan Guesthouse, 24mm holds bed, window-side tub, countryside view, and right bench in natural proportion.

zh-CN.text: 湖畔追跑交给相位对焦，眼睛腾出来留影子

en.text: Let Phase Hybrid AF Hold the Runner While You Frame the Shadow

zh-CN.text: 换到清晨六点五十一分的滴水湖，问题变成怎么在逆光奔跑中同时守住节奏和晨光。这时 S5II 的相位混合对焦替我省出了大半注意力：把焦点稳稳交给它跟着跑者马尾和逆光轮廓走，配合 32mm、1/640s、f/8、ISO 100 既能定格脚步，又能让对岸建筑清楚。我真正盯着看的其实是脚下沥青路有没有留够——一旦把人放在画面正中，地面长长的斜影被裁断，清晨的空气感也丢了一半。

en.text: At Dishui Lake at 06:51, the problem flipped from static scale to moving backlight. Here the S5II’s phase hybrid autofocus earned its keep by locking onto the backlit runner’s stride while 32mm at 1/640s, f/8, and ISO 100 kept both flying hair and distant lakeshore crisp. Free from chasing focus manually, I could watch the bottom third of the frame—because centering her and clipping her long diagonal shadow would erase half the early-morning light.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 32mm · 1/640s · f/8 · ISO 100 · 06:51

zh-CN.caption: 06:51 滴水湖畔 32mm 抓拍，相位对焦跟住逆光跑者，构图刻意向下留出整条柏油路斜影。

en.caption: At 06:51 along Dishui Lake, 32mm pairs phase hybrid AF tracking on the backlit runner with low framing for the full shadow.

zh-CN.text: 窄露台整桌敬酒：16mm 解决的是“别漏掉谁”

en.text: At a Packed Terrace Table, 16mm Protects Who Was There

zh-CN.text: 晚上八点五十七分到了上海宝格丽露台求婚现场，包间木墙窄、两张长桌坐满十多位亲友，退无可退。前后的求婚动作我用中焦抓情绪，但全桌举杯这一刻必须立刻切上 16–35mm F4 的 16mm 广角端（1/60s、f/4、ISO 100），把最靠近镜头两端的亲友、木墙老照片和左侧玻璃门上的 BVLGARI 字样全部保住。再比如之前拍浦东美术馆导览片，现场最怕反而是讲解声被展厅混响盖住——每次出发配器材，我先排查的永远是那件“一旦漏了就补不回来”的事。

en.text: At 20:57 inside Bvlgari Shanghai’s wood-paneled terrace lounge, fourteen friends and family crowded both sides of two long tables with walls right at my back. Tight frames handled individual hugs and tears, yet for the full-table toast I needed the 16–35mm f/4 at 16mm (1/60s, f/4, ISO 100) so neither guest nearest the edges—nor the etched BVLGARI doorway on the left—got cropped out. On our Museum of Art Pudong tour film, by contrast, the first risk was clean vocal audio from the guide. Before packing a single lens, I look for what a job cannot afford to lose.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 16-35/F4 · 16mm · 1/60s · f/4 · ISO 100 · 20:57

zh-CN.caption: 20:57 宝格丽上海露台室内以 16mm 收下整桌十四位亲友举杯画面，保留木墙挂画与左侧玻璃门标识。

en.caption: At 20:57 inside Bvlgari Shanghai Terrace, 16mm holds all fourteen guests raising glasses along with the wood paneling and etched door.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
拍商业空间先用双脚找家具真实比例，再决定广角端留多少墙面与前景
动态人像开启可靠追踪对焦后，把余力放回构图边缘、运动方向和地面影长
狭窄包间聚会提前备好 16mm 级超广角，确保全桌合影不裁掉贴边坐着的亲友
每接一个项目先写下“最容易漏掉的一环”（尺度、影子、全员、收音），再决定背包清单

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Establish true room proportions on foot before widening the lens in tight hospitality spaces
Hand subject tracking to reliable AF on outdoor motion jobs so your eye stays on edges and shadows
Carry a 16mm-class wide zoom for private dining rooms where everyone hugs the walls
Identify the single easiest element to lose on each assignment—scale, shadow, full guest count, or voice audio—before packing

zh-CN.title: RFG Studio 平时怎么干活：从企业门口、赛道维修区到美术馆展厅
zh-CN.dek: 我是 Richard Shen，RFG Studio 主理人。客户找过来时很少只买抽象风格，多半是有一件具体的现场要拍明白。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 不管门前站着二十二人的工业揭牌队伍，还是发车区刚扣上手套的车手，我们在现场做的都是同一件事：把流程提前理顺，不错过只有一次的瞬间。

en.title: How RFG Studio Works: From Corporate Entrances to Pit Lanes and Museum Floors
en.dek: I’m Richard Shen, founder of RFG Studio in Shanghai. Clients rarely show up asking for vague style—they come with a concrete room, schedule, and deadline.
en.pull_quote: Whether twenty-two people are lining up outside a plant or a driver is fastening gloves in pit lane, the work is identical: sort the logistics early so one-shot moments stay calm.

zh-CN.text: 工业活动：先排好门前站位，再抬相机按快门

en.text: Corporate Events: Sort the Facade and Lineup Before Lifting the Camera

zh-CN.text: 客户找上门时很少只买抽象风格，往往是当天那场活动只有一次机会。我是 Richard，RFG 全称 Rich First Generation，在上海做摄影、视频和双语后期，业务由奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司规范执行。拿「中船动力（集团）有限公司」这场户外合影来说，重点不在花哨调色，而是几十秒内把二十二人排成前九后十三两排，让红横幅、公司招牌和左侧实验室资质牌完整露出，蓝工装同事也不被切边。

en.text: Clients rarely call RFG Studio for abstract style—usually there is one real schedule and zero second takes. I’m Richard—RFG stands for Rich First Generation—working across commercial stills, film, and bilingual post-production in Shanghai through Yi Yaoxu (Shanghai) Media Technology Co., Ltd. On this outdoor portrait for CSSC Power (Group) Co., Ltd., the real craft wasn’t colour grading; it was lining up twenty-two people cleanly into two rows in under a minute so the ceremony banner, building title, and left-wall qualification plaques all stayed unobstructed.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力公司大门前的二十二人正式合影，红色揭牌横幅、企业标识与左侧实验室资质牌完整入框。

en.caption: Twenty-two attendees arranged outside CSSC Power’s entrance with the red banner, corporate title, and left-wall lab plaques intact.

zh-CN.text: 汽车与赛事：守在维修区边缘，拍下发车前的紧绷感

en.text: Motorsport Coverage: Reading Pit-Lane Timing Before the Car Rolls Out

zh-CN.text: 汽车与赛事一直是我投入最多精力的方向之一。2025 年 6 月去福建平潭如意湖国际城市赛道拍 SRO GT Cup 莲花车队时，烈日下容易只顾着冲弯道追焦，我却花了不少时间守在维修区边线。同一台黄色 20 号莲花赛车，车房检查、发车整备和高速过弯是三种情绪：正午阳光下，李治廷穿黑色 OMP 赛服低头拉紧 Sparco 手套，旁边戴耳机的 Team Lotus 技师随时待命，哪怕车还没起步，赛场的气场已经立住了。

en.text: Automotive and racing work has always been central to what we shoot. Covering Team Lotus at the SRO GT Cup on Pingtan’s Ruyi Lake street circuit in June 2025, it’s tempting to camp solely at the corners, yet some of the strongest frames happen in pit lane before cars roll out. Catching driver Aarif in his black OMP race suit and yellow-and-black helmet fastening his Sparco gloves beside the yellow #20 Lotus while a radio-equipped Team Lotus crew member checks readiness carries full race-day tension before a lap is turned.

zh-CN.caption: 平潭城市赛道烈日下，莲花车队 20 号赛车旁车手李治廷整理手套，身后佩戴对讲耳机的车队成员随时待命。

en.caption: In bright Pingtan sun beside the #20 Lotus, driver Aarif adjusts his gloves while a radio-equipped Team Lotus crew member watches.

zh-CN.text: 美术馆与混合协作：按项目大小拆合，把时间还给画面

en.text: Museum Tours and Flexible Crews: Scaling Around What the Day Requires

zh-CN.text: 转进浦东美术馆 4C 展厅拍「少儿创艺之城」，节奏又回到公共空间里的克制与清晰。15:05 用 Sony A7V 配 FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G 在 35mm、1/160s、f/4、ISO 1250 站在导览外围，让菲菲老师的手势、渐变高塔模型、听讲的亲子观众和背后“共创城市地图”一次理顺。在 RFG Studio，我们既能独立接下“策划踩点—平面与视频拍摄—双语字幕剪辑”全流程，也能清爽嵌入客户既有的制片班底分工合作，核心始终是提前把对接人与发稿时间表定死。

en.text: Step inside Gallery 4C at the Museum of Art Pudong, and the rhythm shifts to quiet clarity in a public space. Shooting at 15:05 on a Sony A7V with the FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G at 35mm, 1/160s, f/4, and ISO 1250 from the outer edge aligned Feifei’s gesture, the iridescent model towers, visiting families, and the collaborative map wall cleanly. Whether RFG Studio handles an assignment end to end—scouting, stills, video, bilingual subtitles—or embeds inside a client’s wider production crew, locking one clear approver and delivery timeline early keeps every shoot focused.

blocks.exif: Sony A7V · FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G · 35mm · 1/160s · f/4 · ISO 1250 · 15:05

zh-CN.caption: 15:05 35mm 浦东美术馆导览现场：讲解员、亲子观众、地标模型与后方共创城市地图墙清晰衔接。

en.caption: At 15:05 at 35mm inside Museum of Art Pudong, educator Feifei links families, model skyscrapers, and the collaborative map wall.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
进场先锁定当日不可重来的时间节点：企业门前大合影、维修区发车整备或美术馆导览场次
户外团体合影提前踩好建筑招牌、红横幅与两排站位宽度，避免边缘人员或铭牌被切
按项目体量灵活选择独立全包交付或嵌入现有制片组，现场只对接单一确认人
所有商业拍摄、双语后期及企业对公结算均由奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司规范承接

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Lock one-shot schedule anchors upfront—outdoor group lineups, pit-lane prep windows, or timed museum tours
Scout building lettering, banners, and row widths before posing large corporate groups
Deploy RFG Studio either as a self-contained stills/film/bilingual unit or embedded inside an existing crew with one approver
Execute commercial contracting, delivery SLAs, and formal invoicing through Yi Yaoxu (Shanghai) Media Technology Co., Ltd.

zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 6 月平潭城市赛道，黄黑涂装车很好认，真正让团队纪实成立的却不止车身。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 排车队纪实不在于每张图有多抢眼，而在上一张把空间交代清楚后，下一张顺势把视线带进车窗里。

en.title: SRO GT Cup Pingtan: Keeping Drivers, Garages and the City in Play
en.dek: On Pingtan's street circuit in June 2025, the yellow GT4 cars stood out instantly—yet the team story lived just as much in the garage doors.
en.pull_quote: A team documentary isn't about making every frame shout; once a wide apron shot places the circuit, the next frame can slip quietly through the window net.

zh-CN.text: 2025 年 6 月 28 日在福建平潭如意湖街道赛现场，黄黑涂装一进画面就很抓眼。正因为车身颜色太醒目，如果只拍车不拍人，翻几页就很容易变成重复的车辆图鉴。

en.text: On June 28, 2025 at the Pingtan Ruyi Lake Street Circuit in Fujian, the yellow race livery popped on sight. That visibility is exactly why a full edit of solo car shots starts repeating within four frames.

zh-CN.text: 车只露半截，留出车手与头盔之间的临场状态

en.text: Crop Half the Bodywork to Hold the Driver's Prep Before Pit-Out

zh-CN.text: 在 36 号维修间门口拍莲花车队纪实时，我有意让黄色赛车只露出一角车顶或车窗，把重心交给车与人之间的几寸距离。无论是穿着赛道走线印字白 T 恤、戴着橙色耳塞与麦夹在车顶碳纤维头盔旁短暂停顿的瞬间，还是随后换上全套黑黄赛服、一边调整耳内对讲一边守在彩绘头盔旁准备登车的状态，人物的站姿都解释了“头盔为什么此刻放在车顶上”。要是只把头盔裁成一张静物小品，现场的紧张节奏就少了一半。

en.text: Working around garage bay 36 for the Lotus team documentary, I repeatedly let the yellow race car fill just the lower corner so the frame stayed with the person beside it. First in a white circuit-line tee with earplug and mic beside a bare carbon helmet on its HANS collar, then suited up in black-and-yellow race overalls checking an in-ear radio beside the custom helmet on the roof—keeping the driver's stance explains why the gear sits there at that exact minute instead of turning it into an isolated prop still life.

zh-CN.caption: 36 号维修间内，戴着耳塞与领夹麦的队员站在黄顶 GT 赛车旁，车顶放着碳纤维头盔，身后是备用轮胎架。

en.caption: Outside garage 36, a team member wearing an earplug and mic pauses beside the carbon helmet resting on the yellow GT roof ahead of spare slicks.

zh-CN.caption: 身穿黑黄赛车服的车手站在 GT Cup 赛车旁调试耳内无线电，定制图案的碳纤维头盔稳稳搁在车顶护颈上。

en.caption: A driver in black-and-yellow race overalls adjusts his radio earpiece next to his custom-painted helmet balanced on the yellow GT Cup roof.

zh-CN.text: 退到正午烈日下的发车区，让平潭城市天际线进画

en.text: Stepping Out Into Coastal Glare to Ground the Street Circuit

zh-CN.text: 平潭如意湖街道赛是一条搭建在福建海滨的临时城市街道赛道。不像四周只有砂石缓冲区和树林的永久封闭赛场，在这里，水泥防撞墙外紧挨着的就是海滨大道与城市高层住宅。从昏暗的维修间退到发车区外侧阳光下，两台前后停靠的黄黑 GT4 赛车旁站满了身穿黑队服的技师与弯腰探进驾驶门的工程师，而防撞网之外就是平潭标志性的弧形钢架玻璃场馆与高耸楼群。刻意让这些纵向的城市建筑进入画面，整组报道才不会混同于普通永久赛场的常规图库，品牌和车迷一眼就知道车队在海岛城市街道边作战。

en.text: Pingtan Ruyi Lake Street Circuit is a temporary coastal urban street circuit in Pingtan, Fujian. Unlike permanent closed tracks surrounded by gravel traps and trees, residential and city towers alongside waterfront avenues rise right behind the concrete barriers here. Stepping from the shaded garage out onto the sunlit pit apron frames two yellow-and-black GT4 cars surrounded by mechanics and a leaning race engineer, while Pingtan's sweeping steel-ribbed exhibition hall and apartment blocks climb directly behind the FIA fence. Letting that vertical environmental architecture into the frame is what separates Pingtan from a generic circuit gallery—giving sponsors and fans an unmistakable wide anchor on island city streets.

zh-CN.caption: 烈日下的维修区外侧，技师与白衬衫工程师正围着两台 GT4 赛车做最后检查，护栏外是平潭标志性的钢构玻璃馆与高楼。

en.caption: Out in midday glare on the apron, mechanics and a white-shirted engineer check two GT4 cars against Pingtan's steel-arch hall and city skyline.

zh-CN.text: 前一张交代完室外空间，这一张顺势穿过车窗安全网

en.text: Once the Wide Location Holds, Slip Through the Window Net

zh-CN.text: 如果单独抽出一张透过车窗安全网拍座舱的竖图，第一眼很容易只看见玻璃反光和黑色尼龙网带。但把它接在刚才那张发车区全景和车手备战后面，读者的视线就会自动穿过 SCHROTH 网带，直接落到坐在赛用桶椅里戴好头盔的车手、以及在对侧车窗探身做发车前沟通的工程师脸上。编辑排序时，前一张把注意力引到哪里，往往比单张图够不够花哨更关键。

en.text: Shown in isolation, a vertical shot through the passenger window net risks reading like glare and nylon webbing first. Sequenced directly after the sunlit apron overview and garage prep, your eye pushes straight through the SCHROTH mesh to lock onto the helmeted driver seated in the Lotus bucket seat while the engineer briefs him from the opposite window. In a team edit, where the preceding frame aims the viewer's attention matters more than any single flashy crop.

zh-CN.caption: 竖构图透过 SCHROTH 车窗安全网拍向座舱内部，戴好头盔的车手正隔着方向盘聆听对侧白衬衫工程师做赛前嘱咐。

en.caption: Through the SCHROTH window net, the helmeted driver listens intently across the cockpit as the white-shirted engineer delivers a final pre-session briefing.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
维修区人物抓拍尽量保留车手与头盔、赛服或门框标牌的呼应关系，避免孤立拍静物
城市街道赛务必退到发车区外侧留一张宽景，将海滨场馆、建筑与赛道围栏一并收进
趁发车前车窗网刚挂好、车手未出通道的几分钟间隙，贴近对侧光线抢拍座舱沟通瞬间
正午强光与阴影棚房反复切换时提前锁好曝光与高光保护，保住亮色涂装与白衬衫层次

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Keep drivers and crew beside helmets and livery edges in garage frames instead of shooting isolated gear props
Step outside the shaded pit box for at least one wide apron frame that ties street-circuit landmarks to the cars
Catch cockpit briefings right after window nets clip in and before pit-exit release clears the apron
Protect highlights when crossing between dark garage interiors and midday sun on bright yellow paint and white shirts

zh-CN.title: 美术馆导览拍摄：讲解说完这一句，镜头得留人看展品
zh-CN.dek: 在上海浦东美术馆拍「少儿创艺之城」导览视频与纪实摄影，节奏要迁就的不是摄影师，而是双语字幕与看模型的时间。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 信息念完了不代表观众看进去了；讲解落定后多留两秒空镜，孩子搭的城和看展的人才真正走进同一段节奏里。

en.title: Museum Tour Pacing: Leave Time to Look After the Guide Finishes Speaking
en.dek: Filming and photographing the Creative City programme at the Museum of Art Pudong meant pacing shots around live family tours, display heights, and bilingual subtitles.
en.pull_quote: Finishing a spoken line isn’t the same as letting the viewer see the model; holding two quiet beats after the guide pauses is what lets a gallery film breathe.

zh-CN.text: 中庭开口先留字框：双语字幕与人名条都在画面下五分之一

en.text: Atrium Intros: Framing Around Lower-Thirds and Two-Language Subtitles

zh-CN.text: 美术馆导览最怕的不是展厅暗，而是剪完才发现双语字幕压住了模型。浦东美术馆由让·努维尔建筑事务所（Ateliers Jean Nouvel）设计，2021 年 7 月在陆家嘴黄浦江畔开馆、与外滩隔江相望；设计灵感取自马列维奇的《白上之白》（White on White），通体以暖白色花岗岩饰面，西侧标志性的双层“大玻璃（Grand Verre）”幕墙更把对岸外滩的江景倒影揽进室内。在这座讲究克制光影、严格禁止闪光灯的美术馆里拍「大地之眼·少儿创艺之城」，我们要同时交出一支双语导览影片和筑乐园在 4C 展厅的纪实照片。中庭开场站在巨幅吊幔下，“打开时间之门”“少儿创艺之城”和相邻展讯横幅都在身后；拍筑乐园菲菲老师导赏时，脚下刻意留出余量，后期人名条与双语字幕放上去才不会遮住她手里的折页或切碎建筑线条。

en.text: The real trap on a museum tour film isn’t dim lighting—it’s realizing your subtitles cover the model in the edit. Designed by Ateliers Jean Nouvel and opened in July 2021 on the Lujiazui Huangpu Riverbank directly across from the Bund, the Museum of Art Pudong takes inspiration from Malevich’s White on White, clad in warm white granite with a double-layered Grand Verre west glass facade framing Bund reflections. Working inside a daylit white-granite museum bound by strict no-flash gallery etiquette, we delivered both a bilingual subtitled tour film and still documentary coverage for The Gaia Eye · A Children’s Creative City with partner Zhuleyuan in Gallery 4C. Framing educator Feifei beneath the atrium’s hanging banners—Once Upon a Time alongside The Gaia Eye and neighbouring exhibitions—left clean lower-fifth margin so her name tag and two-line bilingual captions never clip her leaflet or overhead type.

zh-CN.caption: 浦东美术馆中庭开场镜头：筑乐园菲菲老师在展览巨幅吊幔前导赏，下方为人名条与双语字幕留出安全区。

en.caption: In the museum atrium, Zhuleyuan educator Feifei opens the tour beneath exhibition banners with safe margins for graphics and bilingual captions.

zh-CN.text: 15:05 跟拍亲子人流，17:01 再降到展台高度看模型

en.text: 15:05 With Families Moving, 17:01 Down at Plinth Height

zh-CN.text: 公共美术馆严守无闪光礼仪，既不能架大灯，也不能拦住普通观众动线，最省心的做法是按高峰和散场拆开拍。在让·努维尔设计的白石材展厅里，柔和的漫射日光沿着大玻璃外墙与展厅高窗渗进来，和天花展陈射灯交织成温柔反光；没有额外补光，反倒要顺着这份自然反射去控反差，别让模型亚克力或纸面拉出刺眼高光，同时保住彩色积木在白墙前的质感。17:01 展厅稍微安静后，我换上 Sony A7V 与 FE 24-105mm F4 G OSS，以 54mm、1/160s、f/4、ISO 800 把镜头降到与模型展台齐平。前景是虚化的彩色积木高楼和白色纸房子，视线穿过楼宇间隙，刚好落在墙面“共创城市地图 Mapping your MAP”的彩色手绘小纸屋上；右角落折叠好的黑色婴儿车也留在边角里，说明这确实是一个向家庭敞开的展厅。

en.text: Because strict no-flash gallery etiquette forbids strobes, light stands, and roping off visitors, splitting coverage across peak tour hours and quieter afternoon windows works best. Inside Nouvel’s warm white granite rooms, soft daylight reflections drifting from the Grand Verre side mix gently with overhead gallery spots—meaning exposure hinges on letting diffused ambient light model the paper and block towers without catching harsh glare on acrylic cases. At 17:01, with the room calmer, I switched to the Sony A7V and FE 24-105mm F4 G OSS at 54mm, 1/160s, f/4, and ISO 800 and lowered the lens to display height. Softly blurred coloured block towers lead past white paper buildings straight onto the “Mapping your MAP” wall—even a folded stroller parked near the exit quietly marks the family-friendly space.

blocks.exif: Sony A7V · FE 24-105mm F4 G OSS · 54mm · 1/160s · f/4 · ISO 800 · 17:01

zh-CN.caption: 17:01 54mm 展台等高视角：虚化的彩色建筑模型让出视野，把后方贴满儿童画作的共创城市地图墙带入景深。

en.caption: At 17:01 at 54mm from display height, out-of-focus model blocks frame the note-covered collaborative city map wall beyond.

zh-CN.text: 讲解员停下来的那两秒，剪辑和隐私都要照顾到

en.text: Holding Two Beats After the Guide Pauses—While Respecting Family Privacy

zh-CN.text: 回到早两小时的 15:05 导览现场，我用 FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G 的 35mm 端、1/160s、f/4、ISO 1250 站在家庭队伍外侧，全程不开闪光、不凑近打断讲解与观展秩序：菲菲老师拿着无线麦指向透明渐变高塔和螺旋高楼模型，踩在街道地图地贴上的孩子们大多只拍到背影或侧颜，既留住了好奇盯紧模型的专注感，也平衡了讲解员、亲子家庭与展品之间的关系，照顾了未成年观众在公共项目里的影像边界。剪辑时我们还会刻意在每句解说完多留两秒画面——配合美术馆本身不紧不慢的看展节奏，观众刚读完中英字幕，正好能跟着手势把模型看进去。

en.text: Two hours earlier at 15:05 during the live tour, shooting at 35mm on the FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G (1/160s, f/4, ISO 1250) kept me outside the family huddle without flash or intrusive movement. Feifei points toward the iridescent blue-green tower and spiral skyscraper models while children standing on the street-map floor appear mostly from behind or in side profile—balancing docent, families, and artworks while protecting young visitors’ privacy in a public programme. In the edit, holding two extra seconds after every line matches the unhurried feel of the museum itself, letting viewers finish reading both languages and actually find the building she pointed to.

blocks.exif: Sony A7V · FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G · 35mm · 1/160s · f/4 · ISO 1250 · 15:05

zh-CN.caption: 15:05 35mm 导览现场：菲菲老师在渐变高塔前为亲子观众讲解，后方共创城市地图墙已贴满手绘作品。

en.caption: At 15:05 at 35mm, Feifei guides families past the iridescent model towers in front of the note-filled collaborative city wall.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
提前向馆方报备拍摄，将带亲子人流的导览时段与清场后的展陈低机位拆开拍摄
导览出镜预先在下五分之一留白，确保人名条与中英双语字幕不压到模型和手册
解说词每说完一句在剪辑点多留 1.5–2 秒模型画面，留足观众读字与找作品的时间
面对未成年参与者优先拍背影、侧颜及手工动作，公开发布前与合作方确认授权范围

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Clear museum permits ahead of time and split live guided tours from calmer detail-height passes
Leave clean lower-fifth headroom on presenter frames so lower-thirds and bilingual subtitles never hide artworks
Hold cuts 1.5–2 seconds past spoken lines so audiences can read captions and locate each model
Favor rear, three-quarter, and hands-on angles around children and verify public release clearances with partners

zh-CN.title: 滴水湖清晨跑步人像：把影子、去向和对岸留全
zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 5 月 2 日从 06:34 拍到 07:08，太阳每升起十几分钟，地上的影子长度和湖面颜色都在变——三张同一段湖岸路，靠的是三个不同的距离。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 运动人像拍到最后，决定画面有没有呼吸感的往往不是人物占了多大面积，而是脚下影子与身前去向留了多少空地。

en.title: Running at Dishui Lake: Leave Room for Shadow, Stride, and Shore
en.dek: Between 06:34 and 07:08 on May 2, 2025, shifting dawn sunlight turned one lakeside stretch into three distinct frames across three focal lengths.
en.pull_quote: In outdoor running portraits, the feeling of pace rarely comes from filling the frame with the runner—it comes from the ground left for the shadow and path ahead.

zh-CN.text: 06:51 的 32mm：别为了拍满人把影子裁断

en.text: 06:51 at 32mm: Don’t Clip the Morning Shadow to Fill the Frame

zh-CN.text: 2025 年 5 月 2 日清晨六点五十一分，滴水湖的太阳还贴在左上方天际。低角度侧逆光把跑者的帽檐、飘起的马尾和淡紫色运动服边缘勾出一圈亮边，同时在深色柏油路上拉出一道极长的影子。拍竖幅跑步人像最容易犯的错，就是急着把人拍大、脚底贴着下边框——我故意用 32mm 把相机往下压，在脚下留出整段黑灰色路面，让长影一直斜着走到底边，配合 1/640s、f/8、ISO 100 稳住动作与对岸建筑。

en.text: At 06:51 on May 2, 2025, the morning sun still sat low over Dishui Lake. Strong side-backlight rimmed the runner’s visor, flying ponytail, and pale lavender jacket while throwing a sharp shadow across dark asphalt. In a vertical frame it is tempting to zoom in until shoes touch the bottom edge; instead, I held 32mm at 1/640s, f/8, and ISO 100 and tilted lower so her entire shadow ran out to the corner while keeping the opposite shore readable.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 32mm · 1/640s · f/8 · ISO 100 · 06:51

zh-CN.caption: 06:51 滴水湖柏油跑道上的逆光奔跑，32mm 竖构图刻意留出脚下长影与湖对岸弧形场馆轮廓。

en.caption: At 06:51 along the Dishui Lake path, 32mm keeps the backlit runner’s long diagonal shadow and the curved pavilion across the water.

zh-CN.text: 06:34 的 35mm：前面留出空路，人才能真的跑起来

en.text: 06:34 at 35mm: Open Pavement Ahead Carries the Stride

zh-CN.text: 再往前回看十七分钟，06:34 在混凝土堤岸边用 16–35mm 镜头的 35mm 端拍她刚跑过桥下的瞬间。她朝左前方迈步，我把人物摆在偏右侧，故意让左前方留出一大片空路面和草坪边角。如果为了工整把她放进画面正中间，人虽然清楚，整张照却会像停在原地摆拍；对运动品牌或个人肖像客户来说，约早上六点半进场看似辛苦，换来的正是这段空旷跑道和干净光影。

en.text: Seventeen minutes earlier at 06:34, I caught her passing along the concrete promenade with the 16–35mm set to 35mm (1/640s, f/8, ISO 100). Because she was moving from right to left, I placed her toward the right third and left clean empty pavement and grass ahead of her gaze. Center her cleanly in the rectangle and she looks paused; leaving open ground in front pulls the viewer’s eye forward—and explains why booking a 06:30 call time pays off with empty paths and clean dawn rays.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 16-35/F4 · 35mm · 1/640s · f/8 · ISO 100 · 06:34

zh-CN.caption: 06:34 在临湖石栏步道用 35mm 拍出奔跑去向，人物偏右构图，身前大片空路与斜影一同延伸。

en.caption: At 06:34 on the lakeside seawall, 35mm places the runner on the right so empty path and morning shadow lead forward.

zh-CN.text: 07:08 拉到 83mm：用长焦压缩把滴水湖地标拉近

en.text: 07:08 at 83mm: Using Telephoto Compression to Anchor Location

zh-CN.text: 到了七点零八分，太阳升高，影子缩到脚边，湖水也透出湛蓝色，参数变成 83mm、1/400s、f/5.6、ISO 64。退远改用中长焦压缩空间后，对岸那座标志性的双子塔建筑一下子从天边拉到了跑者正后方，左侧高杆路灯与下方红绿灌木虚化成框。近处看神态与影子、中距看去向、83mm 交代她在上海滴水湖跑步——同一段晨跑路线，三个焦段交出的完全是三件不同的事。

en.text: By 07:08, higher light shortened shadows to her heels and turned the water crisp blue. Switching back to the 24–105mm at 83mm (1/400s, f/5.6, ISO 64) pulled the distinctive twin-tower skyline across Dishui Lake straight behind her, framed by the black lamppost on the left and soft red-tipped shrubs at the bottom edge. One short lakeside run yields stride, shadow, and unmistakable Shanghai geography—simply by stepping back and changing focal distance.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 83mm · 1/400s · f/5.6 · ISO 64 · 07:08

zh-CN.caption: 07:08 阳光升高后切到 83mm，将对岸双子塔轮廓压回跑者身后，路灯与前景灌木收束视线。

en.caption: At 07:08 in brighter morning sun, 83mm compresses the distant twin towers right behind the runner with foreground foliage.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
户外清晨跑步拍摄建议抢在日出后 06:30–07:15 窗口，兼顾低角度长影、空旷路面与凉爽体感
拍摄动向画面时把人物放在进画一侧，在眼睛与脚步前方至少留出三分之一空路
遇低角度侧逆光务必检查脚下影长，宁可人物略小也不要从脚踝切断阴影
最后拉一组 70–85mm 中长焦侧面追拍，把对岸天际线或地标建筑压缩进人物身后交代地点

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Schedule lakeside running shoots between 06:30 and 07:15 for long directional shadows and uncluttered paths
Place the runner toward the trailing side of the frame so at least a third of open path lies ahead
Check the bottom border under low sun—keep the full ground shadow intact rather than cropping tight at the shoes
Finish with an 80mm-range profile pan to compress distant shoreline landmarks right behind the subject

zh-CN.title: 民宿客房，怎么拍才像住进去看到的样子
zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 2 月 24 日下午在书院民宿，十二分钟的窗光里，我用 24mm 守住家具尺度与暗部层次，再用 57mm 接上软装细节。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 好用的民宿客房照不是把屋子拉得像套房，而是让住客推门那一刻能立刻认出：这就是自己下单的那间房。

en.title: Photographing a Guesthouse Room So Guests Recognise It on Arrival
en.dek: Across twelve minutes of afternoon light at Shuyuan Guesthouse on February 24, 2025, 24mm frames hold true room proportions and natural window falloff before 57mm closes in on details.
en.pull_quote: Honest hospitality photographs don’t stretch a bedroom into a ballroom—they make sure a guest walks through the door and instantly recognises the room they booked.

zh-CN.text: 24mm 先看尺度，不往墙角退死角

en.text: At 24mm, Resist Backing Into the Corner Just to Add Wall

zh-CN.text: 很多民宿主理人最初找摄影师时，都会问一句“能不能拍得更显大一点”。可在实际运营里，用超广角死贴着墙角往外拉，往往会在住客推门那一刻埋下失望：边上的浴缸被畸变拉长，床和椅子看着隔了三米，真住进来却转身就碰。下午三点四十二分在书院民宿拍这间临窗客房时，我用松下 S5II 配 24–105mm 的 24mm 端（1/250s、f/5、ISO 100），刻意往前站了半步——宁可少带两尺墙面，也要让左侧红墙、床尾、白浴缸和右侧黑色皮沙发保持正常比例，窗外树影与周边白墙瓦顶屋舍也一眼看得出环境安静。

en.text: Hospitality owners often ask if photos can make a room look bigger, yet cramming an ultra-wide lens into the farthest corner usually backfires at check-in. Corners stretch the freestanding tub out of scale and make a cozy room feel misleadingly huge online. Inside Shuyuan Guesthouse at 15:42 on the S5II and 24–105mm (24mm, 1/250s, f/5, ISO 100), I stepped slightly forward from the corner—trading a strip of extra ceiling and wall so the coral molding wall, bed corner, soaking tub, black leather bench, and white-walled neighborhood rooftops outside all sit at honest eye-level proportions.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 24mm · 1/250s · f/5 · ISO 100 · 15:42

zh-CN.caption: 15:42 书院民宿客房全景：斜射午后日光落在左侧红墙，白浴缸、皮沙发、球形落地灯与窗外村舍关系一目了然。

en.caption: At 15:42, afternoon sun strikes the coral wall while 24mm maps the bed corner, tub, tufted bench, floor lamp, and quiet neighborhood outside.

zh-CN.text: 15:46 的窗边过渡：保留暗部才能看出午后光线

en.text: 15:46 Beside the Glass: Let the Wall Turn Darker Away From the Window

zh-CN.text: 四分钟后移到床侧近拍浴缸角（24mm、1/125s、f/4.5、ISO 100），这间房最迷人的是光线明暗转折：窗帘和浴缸向窗那一面泛着清亮天光，粉色鹅卵石围边地垫和黑色床头柜往左侧红墙转过去时亮度自然沉下来，而窗外绿树也没过曝成白纸。如果按地产样板间那种 HDR 思路把室内外强行拉成一样亮，家具全看清了，下午坐在窗边发呆的光感却全丢了。这也是我总建议民宿客户按朝向挑下午三点半到四点开拍的原因：冬末低斜光带出的明暗层次，开棚灯反而仿不出来。

en.text: Four minutes later at 15:46, stepping beside the bed for the tub corner (24mm, 1/125s, f/4.5, ISO 100), the goal was protecting natural falloff. Bright daylight wraps the white tub curve and monstera-leaf curtain tieback while the coral wall behind the black brass-knob nightstand steps gently darker—and the trees outside stay green instead of clipping white. Flatten all three tones with heavy HDR and you see every stitch, yet lose what sitting there at four in the afternoon feels like. Booking a late-afternoon natural-light window beats blasting strobes across small bedrooms.

zh-CN.caption: 15:46 从床沿望向白浴缸与鹅卵石地垫，黑色床头柜一侧的红墙自然过渡到暗部，窗外绿意仍保住细节。

en.caption: At 15:46 beside the bed, natural window falloff sculpts the white soaking tub, pebble mat, and black nightstand without blowing out the trees.

zh-CN.text: 15:54 推到 57mm：先看全屋，再进软装特写

en.text: 15:54 at 57mm: Vignettes Only Land After the Room Makes Sense

zh-CN.text: 八分钟后站远一点拉到 57mm（1/60s、f/4、ISO 100），专拍墙边五斗柜、线描水仙挂画、黑瓷瓶里的蝴蝶兰与右侧小巧的复古留声机摆件。右侧窗光轻扫在柜面和花瓣上，让黑漆抽屉线条干净利落。对携程或公众号浏览来说，放在全景后面的竖构图细节正好接住手机滑屏，住客先看懂房间布局，再顺着软装审美记住这间民宿。

en.text: Eight minutes later at 15:54, zooming to 57mm (1/60s, f/4, ISO 100) isolated the five-drawer black chest, framed botanical line drawing, mauve phalaenopsis orchids in a ribbed vase, and miniature vintage gramophone. Side window light from the right skims across drawer moldings and petals cleanly. Sequenced after the room overviews, vertical vignettes like this read naturally on a mobile booking page—first grounding the layout, then selling the guesthouse’s taste.

blocks.exif: Lumix S5II · LUMIX S 24-105/F4 · 57mm · 1/60s · f/4 · ISO 100 · 15:54

zh-CN.caption: 15:54 用 57mm 竖构图记录黑色五斗柜、线描花卉挂画、蝴蝶兰与复古留声机摆件，右侧自然窗光带出立体轮廓。

en.caption: At 15:54, 57mm frames the black chest, botanical print, mauve orchids, and mini gramophone lit softly from the right window.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
开拍前按房间窗户朝向排定时间表，抢在阳光斜照进房间的柔和时段入场
主图优先用 24mm 左右真实焦段，避免死退墙角或超广角拉伸导致到店货不对板
保留窗边明暗过渡与适度阴影，同时压住窗外树影与天空细节不过曝
先出横版全景交代家具位置，再补 50mm 级竖幅软装局部适配手机订房页

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Schedule each room around its window orientation to catch angled afternoon or morning daylight rather than flat noon glare
Favor honest 24mm-range room frames over extreme wide corners so check-in matches listing expectations
Preserve gentle shadow falloff away from windows while holding exterior foliage detail
Follow wide landscape layout frames with 50mm-range vertical vignettes tailored to mobile booking galleries

zh-CN.title: 花艺人像，大型花艺与人物怎样互不抢戏
zh-CN.dek: 拍花小念这组品牌形象照，难点不在怎么把花拍鲜艳，而在花盒比人还宽、色彩又极其饱和时，如何让花保住体量、人保住松弛感。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 当花束本身已经占满色彩密度，衣服就该退成一块干净的中性画布，靠坐姿与站姿替花讲出真实体积。

en.title: Balancing Scale and Focus in a Floral Brand Portrait
en.dek: On the Huaxiaonian brand shoot, the challenge wasn’t making the blooms look vibrant—it was styling clothing, spacing, and posture so neither flower nor subject fought for the eye.
en.pull_quote: When an arrangement already carries heavy color density, wardrobe should step back into a calm neutral while posture proves the scale.

zh-CN.text: 花盒体量这么大，浅色牛仔替花守住颜色主角

en.text: When the Arrangement Is Huge, Denim Protects the Color Palette

zh-CN.text: 单拍大型花艺静物，客户在手机上往往看不出它到底有多大。一旦让人物坐到圆桌边，花束的宽度和高度立刻有了参照。花小念这件作品放在矮圆大理石桌上，紫飞燕草、蓝白蝴蝶兰、粉牡丹、黄色嘉兰和紫色棕榈扇铺得极满，背景又是暖灰粉雕花护墙板与人字拼木地板。如果人物穿印花裙或高饱和礼服，画面立刻出现两个互扯眼球的重心；我们定造型时直接选了浅水洗牛仔外套配白T恤与阔腿牛仔裤，既有清晰冷暖反差把人物从暖墙里托出来，又把全套明艳色彩干净让给花材。

en.text: Photograph a grand floral box alone and viewers rarely grasp how tall it really stands. Put someone right beside it and scale clicks in a glance. For Huaxiaonian, the arrangement in a cream hatbox on a low round marble table packs lavender delphiniums, blue-tinted orchids, pink peonies, yellow gloriosa lilies, and pale palm spears against warm mauve paneled walls and chevron oak flooring. Put the subject in loud patterns or rich jewel tones and two things compete immediately. Choosing light-wash denim over a white tee cleanly separates her from the warm wall while leaving all the chromatic punch to the flowers.

zh-CN.caption: 戴深灰棒球帽穿浅色牛仔套装侧坐在圆桌沿，面向花束的姿态一下子托出大型花艺的真实体量。

en.caption: Perched in a charcoal cap and light-wash denim beside the marble table, looking toward the arrangement immediately proves its scale.

zh-CN.text: 靠近拍人像，脸颊与枝叶间要留一口气

en.text: In Closer Frames, Leave Breathing Room Between Hair and Petals

zh-CN.text: 摘掉棒球帽改拍近景时，我最盯紧的是黑发与外探花枝之间的那一小块空隙。一旦让侧脸直接埋进密集花瓣里，观众第一眼容易把人与花看成粘在一起的一整团形状；让她低坐在花桌左侧朝画外望去，留出几厘米浅色墙面透在发梢和垂落白兰之间，再把下方奶油色花盒与牛仔裤腿收进同一幅竖图里，人物神态松弛，花艺层次也没有被裁碎。

en.text: When we took off the cap and moved in closer, the critical check was that small pocket of wall between her hair and the outer stems. Press a cheek straight into dense blooms and the viewer reads hair and foliage as one tangled silhouette. Sitting low on the left side of the table and looking off-frame keeps a slender strip of wall clear beside the trailing white orchids, while the vertical crop holds both the cream hatbox base and her relaxed posture.

zh-CN.caption: 摘帽后贴近低坐，黑发与白兰枝叶间保持细微空隙，让人物眼神与饱满花束各自透气。

en.caption: Seated low without the cap, a sliver of open wall separates dark hair from trailing orchids so neither portrait nor bouquet crowds the other.

zh-CN.text: 不换景不换衣，只靠坐站变化拆出品牌图库

en.text: Seated vs. Standing: Turning One Setup Into a Brand Library

zh-CN.text: 对花艺或生活方式品牌客户来说，想拍出丰富页面并不一定非要换三套衣服、搭三个景。收尾这一幅只让她站到圆桌右后侧、单手插兜直视镜头，画面信息立刻变了：飞燕草花穗高过头顶，主体花球齐肩展开，更多雕花墙板与人字拼木地板露了出来。同一组交付里，品牌既有一张花压倒性占主角的侧坐照，也有一张人站稳主位的形象照，社媒、画册和门头海报都能直接拆用。

en.text: Brand clients don’t always need three wardrobe changes and three backdrops to get versatile assets. For the closing frame, simply asking her to stand behind the right edge of the marble table with one hand in her pocket shifts the balance completely: delphinium spires clear the top of her head while the core bouquet reaches shoulder height, opening up the paneled wall and parquet floor. One calm setup gives the brand a flower-led portrait, a closer mood frame, and a confident eye-contact anchor.

zh-CN.caption: 起身站立在花桌右后侧直视镜头，齐肩花冠与高出头顶的花穗直观交待出整座花艺的实际高度。

en.caption: Standing casually behind the right side of the table with direct eye contact reveals the arrangement rising past shoulder height above her head.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
拍摄色彩浓烈的大型花艺前先与品牌敲定服装色系，优先选牛仔、米白等中性冷调面料让出主色
靠近花艺拍人物肖像时盯紧侧脸、发梢与外伸枝叶的接缝，留出一点墙面底色防粘连
同一布景内用“侧坐看花—低坐留白—站立直视”三组姿态切换，兼顾产品尺度与主理人形象
竖构图尽量保住花盒底座与人物鞋履地面落点，让大件陈设看着稳而不飘

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Align wardrobe tones before shoot day—calm denim or neutrals separate the subject from warm walls without fighting colorful blooms
Watch the gap between face, hair, and projecting petals in closer portraits so shapes stay clean
Cycle across table-perch, low-seated, and standing poses in one setup to cover both floral scale and founder portraiture
Keep the pedestal base and footwear grounded inside vertical frames so oversized arrangements read with weight

zh-CN.title: 活动照片交出去，还要找得到
zh-CN.dek: 从上海中医药大学的讲台，到中船动力的技术参观。拍之前先想客户会怎么找图。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 学术会议和企业大活动，最折磨宣传同事的不是图不够多，而是打开文件夹分不清谁在讲哪一段。

en.title: An event edit people can actually use
en.dek: From a university lectern to a technical tour at CSSC Power. Think about how the client will look for the images.
en.pull_quote: What slows a communications team down after a conference isn’t a shortage of frames—it’s opening a folder and not being able to tell which speaker belongs to which section.

zh-CN.text: 三月二十日上海中医药大学报告厅，发言接连不断，存储卡很快塞满。

en.text: Inside Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine’s auditorium on March 20, back-to-back academic reports fill a memory card in no time.

zh-CN.text: 上海中医药大学与玉森制药在浦东张江全球合作伙伴中心报告厅办的中药创新发展大会暨开业庆典，跟品牌快闪完全不同。机构宣传收图后要逐一对号：谁讲什么课题、现场坐满几排。开拍前先把客户找图逻辑想清楚，比盲目按几千张更有用。

en.text: Co-hosted at the university’s Zhangjiang campus in Pudong alongside Yusen Pharma’s new institute launch, the conference ran a dense academic schedule. Unlike lifestyle pop-ups, institutional editors work strictly by speaker and agenda slot: opening remarks, keynote subject, room turnout. Designing the shoot around how a client searches for images afterward matters far more than piling up thousands of redundant frames.

zh-CN.text: 开场全景先立档：主屏、副屏和前排席卡一次对上号

en.text: Locking hall identity, front-row namecards, and side screens in the opening frame

zh-CN.text: 开场致辞我先从右侧走廊拉一张完整全景：木条墙面、写满主题日期的正红主屏、两侧小副屏、前排红布长桌与嘉宾席卡，加上鲜花讲台发言人。通稿用这一张放开头，不用长篇解释就能交代清楚是哪一场。

en.text: From the right auditorium aisle, the opening wide frame sets every institutional anchor in place: slatted timber walls, the crimson LED banner showing the full conference title and date, twin wall-mounted relay monitors, red-clothed VIP tables lined with printed namecards, and the opening speaker at the floral podium. One frame gives a press release an indisputable anchor.

zh-CN.caption: 报告厅右侧过道拍下的开场全景，红色主题大屏、两侧同步副屏、前排席卡与鲜花讲台完整对应。

en.caption: Opening overview from the right aisle uniting the crimson main screen, twin side monitors, VIP table namecards, and floral podium.

zh-CN.text: 讲台近景别裁太死，给屏幕留出讲者姓名与报告标题

en.text: Keeping speaker name and topic readable inside tight podium frames

zh-CN.text: 拍讲台最怕为了背景干净把框裁太紧，结果几位专家交出去像在同一个蓝底前换了衣服。往侧前方让半步，鹅颈话筒既不挡脸，白底蓝字上的“韩玲”、日期和蓝条课题字样也一起留住，编辑看缩略图就能精准认人。

en.text: Zooming too tight onto a lectern easily leaves every speaker looking identical against the same cropped blue patch. Stepping slightly right kept the slim gooseneck mic clear of the speaker’s mouth while retaining her name, the date, and part of the blue headline behind her—so an editor sorting thumbnails can identify each keynote immediately without checking notes.

zh-CN.caption: 讲台近景刻意保留屏幕上的嘉宾姓名、日期与报告标题，鹅颈话筒贴边避开了面部遮挡。

en.caption: Closer lectern portrait positioned so the gooseneck mic clears the speaker’s face while her name, date, and slide heading stay readable.

zh-CN.text: 从后排看满座与课件，同一套分类习惯也用在多环节企业日

en.text: Reading room scale from the rear rail—and applying the same filing discipline to CSSC Power

zh-CN.text: 后半程退到报告厅后排栏杆外拍了一张全场视角：顶部六盏舞台面光灯架、满座听众背影、右侧站岗的两位会务人员，还有大屏上《中药注册管理专门规定》的严谨表格。这种“按用途交图”的思路放到中船动力那类既有揭牌、技术参观又有合影的企业日里同样管用——讲台、听众、参观各归各自文件夹，客户打开就能用，不用猜文件名后面的数字密码。

en.text: From the back balcony rail, the six overhead stage fixtures, filled seating rows, attentive aisle staff, and detailed regulatory comparison table on screen frame an active academic exchange. That same retrieval logic applies directly to multi-part industrial days like CSSC Power, where unveiling, technical tour, and group portraits live in clearly named phase folders instead of forcing clients to decode raw frame numbers.

zh-CN.caption: 从报告厅后排隔着护栏俯拍全场，灯光桁架、满座听众与屏幕上的法规对比表格交代学术交流规模。

en.caption: Back-of-hall view across the balcony rail capturing the lighting truss, full seating rows, aisle staff, and technical table on screen.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
开场前向会务要一份最终议程表和前排席卡名单，边拍边把讲者顺序核对清楚。
每位发言嘉宾至少保留一张带姓名或课题页边框的讲台近景，方便后期缩略图快速认人。
穿插从报告厅后方高点拍摄听众席与完整学术课件，体现会议参与度与专业浓度。
无论学术论坛还是揭牌参观类企业日，交片按议程或环节建夹，不再一锅端交付流水编号。

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Grab the final printed agenda and front-row seating chart before opening remarks to verify speaker order on the fly.
Keep at least one lectern shot per speaker that includes their name slide or presentation header for instant thumbnail recognition.
Add a rear-of-hall wide showing full audience attendance alongside readable technical slide content.
Organise deliverables by agenda section or ceremony stage rather than handing over an unsorted chronological numbering dump.

zh-CN.title: 百日宴合影之外，我会多等三拍
zh-CN.dek: 百日宴开席前在客房留十五分钟，不强迫一百天的宝宝看镜头，反而能同时收下窗边怀抱、床畔低头凝视和一家三口正脸合影。
zh-CN.pull_quote: 百天宝宝不会配合快门数一二三；与其在旁边打响指逗眼神，不如让妈妈低头看孩子那三秒自然发生。

en.title: Waiting Three Extra Beats Around a 100-Day Family Portrait
en.dek: Carving out fifteen quiet minutes upstairs before a 100-day banquet meant following a sleeping infant's pace—yielding window portraits, bed-side care, and a calm family three-shot.
en.pull_quote: A hundred-day baby doesn't take camera cues; rather than snapping fingers for eye contact, waiting three beats for a mother's quiet glance down makes the memory honest.

zh-CN.text: 窗帘透进柔光，妈妈看着镜头，怀里一百天的宝宝却睡得正沉。碰上这种画面，很多家长会不好意思地想把娃弄醒再拍，我通常直接劝住——这一睁一闭的安静，刚好就是百天最真实的模样。

en.text: Soft daylight through sheer curtains wrapped the sage armchair as the mother looked toward me—while her hundred-day baby slept deeply. Most parents feel apologetic and reach to wake the baby for an open-eyed shot, yet I always ask them to let that stillness stay.

zh-CN.text: 按宝宝的作息走，不强求全员看镜头

en.text: Following the Baby's Nap Rhythm Instead of Forcing Eye Contact

zh-CN.text: 拍百日宴家庭照，最怕一切被楼下宴会厅的开席时间赶着跑。提前二十分钟在采光好的套房里留出一小段空档，先拍妈妈坐在窗边抱着熟睡婴儿的竖构图：针织小袜、蕾丝帽檐和她轻护在袖口边上的手指全在柔光里，既不会惊扰孩子，也让刚忙完准备的新手妈妈喘口气。

en.text: The biggest strain on 100-day shoots is squeezing portraits between banquet welcoming duties downstairs. Carving out fifteen unhurried minutes in a sunlit suite upstairs lets the shoot follow the baby's nap window. Sitting by the sheer window in her cream boucle dress, the mother rests one hand lightly against the baby's knit sleeve while keeping the infant completely undisturbed.

zh-CN.caption: 窗边鼠尾草绿单人沙发上，穿米白肌理裙的妈妈温柔望向镜头，怀中戴蕾丝帽的百天宝宝正安稳熟睡。

en.caption: Seated in a sage armchair beside sheer window light, the mother smiles softly at the camera while her hundred-day baby sleeps in a lace bonnet.

zh-CN.text: 床畔低头看孩子那几秒，喊不出“再来一张”

en.text: Holding Quiet Beside the Bed When Nobody Looks at the Lens

zh-CN.text: 把睡着的宝宝轻轻放到大床白床单上，后面是红蓝传统纹样软包床头。妈妈伏在床边，一手自然护在宝宝头侧，低下头去静静看着小拳头贴在脸蛋边的睡颜，全程没有抬头看相机一眼。这种零距离的照顾一旦叫人“转过来再演一遍”，眼神里的那点松弛立刻就散了，摄影师站近一点安静按快门就好。

en.text: Once we set the sleeping infant onto the crisp white sheets in front of the red-and-navy brocade headboard, the mother leaned onto the mattress, resting one hand near the baby's head and looking quietly down without glancing toward the lens. A glance like that falls flat the second you ask someone to repeat it—all the camera needs to do is wait quietly at the bedside.

zh-CN.caption: 红蓝纹样床头前，穿镂空针织袜的宝宝在白床单上侧脸熟睡，妈妈伏在床畔低头静静守望。

en.caption: Against the red-and-navy patterned headboard, the baby sleeps on crisp white sheets while the mother leans in gently without looking at the camera.

zh-CN.text: 家庭全档和工作室公开精选，是两套不同的挑片逻辑

en.text: Separating the Family Archive From a Concise Public Edit

zh-CN.text: 等宝宝慢慢转醒，穿浅蓝衬衫的爸爸站到床边一起抱起孩子，趁一家三口齐整看过来，我抓了这张横构图合影——父母笑着面对镜头，怀里戴帽的小家伙依然自顾自仰头看着天花板。交到家长手里的全辑里，窗边守候、三口正装照和楼下长辈亲友大合影都会完整保留；但放到工作室专栏里，选这三张不同视线和距离的片子，已经能说清我们怎么在私人庆典里等住真实情绪。

en.text: When the baby finally stirred, the father stepped beside the bed in a pale blue shirt to cradle the infant horizontally for a clean three-person portrait—both parents smiling straight ahead while their little one peered up toward the ceiling. In the private family delivery, sleeping details, hallway welcomes, and multi-generation banquet group shots all belong; in a public studio column, three frames spanning three distinct distances tell the whole story.

zh-CN.caption: 床前红蓝软包背景墙前，穿浅蓝衬衫的爸爸横抱起戴蕾丝帽的宝宝，一家三口留下横幅合影。

en.caption: Standing before the red-and-navy headboard, the father in a pale blue shirt cradles the baby between them for a relaxed horizontal family portrait.

zh-CN.title: 现场速查清单
zh-CN.text:
百日宴开席前预留十五分钟客房自然光档期，顺着宝宝喂奶与小睡节律先拍安静画面
宝宝熟睡时不必硬喊父母转头摆拍，保留低头抚摸、贴脸护手等单向凝视镜头
利用白纱窗帘与床单反光作柔光底，避开频繁闪光惊扰一百天新生儿视力与情绪
清晰区分交付给家庭的完整亲友档案，与仅取两三张代表构图的对外展示精选集

en.title: On-Set Field Checklist
en.text:
Reserve fifteen minutes in a window-lit room before banquet guests arrive to match the baby's nap rhythm
Hold quiet during feeding or sleep transitions rather than cueing parents to look away from their child
Rely on sheer window light and white bed linens as natural fill so flash never startles a 100-day infant
Separate the complete multi-generation family archive from a concise three-frame public studio edit

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄 Café 空间、品牌标识与陈设细节，记录咖啡吧台及英伦街景主题装置。
zh-CN.story:
这次前滩太古里新店开业拍摄，我把 Vivienne Westwood Café 单独整理成一组。先看咖啡吧台，再看标识、菜单和台面上的用品。把这些放在一起，才看得清这间 Café 的具体样子。

红色电话亭、邮筒和巴士站主题陈设，把英伦街景带进了店内。它们有很强的识别度，但这组照片也留下了吧台本身：咖啡店不只有适合拍照的装置，还有点单、制作和陈列的空间。

这套开业照片里还有店铺空镜和产品静物。我选择把三个主题拆开，让读者能分别看空间、Café 和柜内产品；它们来自同一次拍摄，放回一起也能串起完整的新店记录。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Photography for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, documenting the Café counter, branding, display details and British streetscape installation.
en.story:
For the new-store opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan, I have given the Vivienne Westwood Café its own series. The sequence starts with the counter, then moves to signage, menus and counter accessories. Together, these views describe the Café at different scales.

A red telephone box, postbox and bus-stop installation bring a British street setting into the store. They are distinctive elements, but the counter remains part of the story too: the Café is also a space arranged around ordering, preparation and display.

The same shoot includes retail interiors and product still lifes. I have separated the three subjects so each can be viewed in its own right. Read together, they make a fuller record of the new store.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店拍摄店铺空镜，以门头、室内全景、休息区与陈列细节呈现零售空间。
zh-CN.story:
这一篇接着前滩 Café，往店铺里面走。门头交代入口，室内全景交代柜台、通道和陈列的位置。我把这些画面留在一组里，方便先理解空间，再看里面的东西。

弧形展示柜、镜面墙体和沙发休息区，是这套空镜里的几个重点。镜面会把陈列和空间重复带进画面，柜台的弧线又改变了观看方向。全景和局部各有用途，不能只用一种距离看完整间店。

服装、包袋、眼镜、围巾和腰带都在各自的陈列位置上。这篇保留它们与店铺的关系，珠宝和腕表则另放进产品篇。这样看空镜的时候，视线不会总被某一件产品带走。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Retail space photography of the new Vivienne Westwood store at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, covering the storefront, interior views, seating area and merchandise displays.
en.story:
This series continues beyond the Qiantan Café into the retail space. The storefront establishes the entrance; wider interior views show the counters, circulation and displays. I have kept these photographs together so the layout can be understood before its details.

Curved display counters, mirrored walls and the seating area are key parts of the series. Mirrors repeat the displays and the room, while the curves of the counters change the viewing direction. Wider frames and closer details describe different aspects of the interior.

Clothing, bags, eyewear, scarves and belts appear in their display settings. This article keeps those relationships with the room intact, while jewellery and watches receive a separate product story.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影
zh-CN.summary: 在上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄中，以柜内静物和局部特写记录珠宝、珍珠饰品与腕表的陈列细节。
zh-CN.story:
前滩新店开业的第三个主题，是珠宝与腕表。这组是在现场展示柜里完成的静物摄影。我把组合陈列、俯拍和单件特写放在一起，既交代产品的排列，也留下每件东西的细节。

Orb 标识、珍珠饰品、表盘和金属表带，各自需要不同的观看距离。整柜画面能看出系列，近一点才看得见标识、轮廓和材质。玻璃反射与柜内灯光也留在照片里，说明它们当时是怎样被展示的。

我把它单列为产品篇，是因为看产品和看店铺的重点确实不同。这里不需要把整间店重新讲一遍，注意力就放在这些小物件，以及它们在柜台里形成的组合上。

背景资料：Westwood 的 Orb 标志把王权宝球与土星环结合，延续品牌将传统带向未来的想法。标志、珠宝与装饰细节，是这组影像中反复出现的视觉线索。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life
en.summary: Still-life and detail photography of jewellery, pearl accessories and watches, photographed in display cases for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai.
en.story:
Jewellery and watches form the third part of the Qiantan store-opening shoot. These still lifes were photographed in the display cases. Collection views, overhead compositions and individual close-ups show both the arrangements and the details of each piece.

Orb motifs, pearl accessories, watch dials and metal bracelets invite different viewing distances. Collection frames describe the range; closer photographs reveal the motifs, shapes and materials. Glass reflections and display lighting retain the context of the store.

I have made this a separate product story because its focus differs from the interior series. The attention here stays with the small objects and the combinations they form inside the cases.

Background: Westwood’s Orb combines a royal orb with a Saturn-like ring, reflecting the house’s idea of taking tradition into the future. Emblems, jewellery and decorative details recur throughout this series.

zh-CN.title: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座
zh-CN.summary: 与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座，围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开分享，记录讲座现场、腕表展示和陈设细节。
zh-CN.story:
这次与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座。内容围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开，我记录了讲者、听众、腕表展示和现场陈设。

在这组照片里，讲座和产品展示是连着的。讲者与听众的画面交代交流，展示桌、表盘和多色表带则把讲座涉及的对象具体呈现出来。只有会场全景，或者只有腕表特写，都不足以说明这次活动。

专栏里我把这两条线交替放在一起。读者可以先看人在讲什么样的活动，再靠近看腕表；这里记录的是讲座与展示现场，不把它写成没有依据的产品评测。

背景资料：Gerald Charles 由 Gérald Charles Genta 于 2000 年创立。以设计师原始草图为延续的品牌脉络，为这场制表文化讲座提供了清晰的设计背景。
services: 腕表展示及陈设细节摄影
zh-CN.background: Gerald Charles 由 Gérald Charles Genta 于 2000 年创立。以设计师原始草图为延续的品牌脉络，为这场制表文化讲座提供了清晰的设计背景。

en.title: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking
en.summary: A watchmaking culture lecture jointly organised with Meishiwei Workshop at China Merchants Bank Private Banking, exploring Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking through lecture coverage, watch displays and event details.
en.story:
This watchmaking-culture lecture was organised with Treasure Care at China Merchants Bank Private Banking. The programme covered Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking knowledge; my photographs document the speakers, audience, watches and display setting.

The lecture and the product displays belong to the same record. Speaker and audience photographs show the exchange, while tables, dials and coloured straps give the discussion a visible subject. Neither venue views nor watch close-ups alone describe the whole event.

I have interwoven those two strands here, moving from the lecture setting to closer views of the watches. This is a record of the event and its displays, rather than a product review.

Background: Founded by Gérald Charles Genta in 2000, Gerald Charles continues a design lineage rooted in his original drawings. That history provides context for this watchmaking-culture lecture.
services: Watch display and event detail photography

zh-CN.title: Urban Institute｜中国城市建筑考察
zh-CN.summary: 2026 年 5 月 9 日至 16 日，Urban Institute 的建筑与城市发展考察从上海出发，经杭州抵达成都。Richard Shen 负责英文客户对接、三城现场拍摄与影像交付。这里收录 25 张照片，沿着八天行程回看 20 个重点地点。
zh-CN.story:
在上海，沿黄浦江看完城市尺度，再走进石库门和住宅庭院。杭州的两处住区让考察回到材料、动线和居住体验，电梯工厂则把视角转向建筑背后的制造。到成都后，同一片湖水把住宅、社区公园和商业空间串了起来。拍摄跟着队伍走：先留下建筑与环境的关系，再记录大家在沙盘前停下来、进到展厅，以及合影时整个团队在场的样子。

上海 · 5 月 9–12 日

同一条江，给了这四天几种完全不同的尺度。外滩和北外滩适合把人放回城市天际线里，张园与新天地则更适合跟着队伍走进里弄。转入世博滨江、徐汇西岸和虹口的新住宅后，观看的重点从街道变成了入口、园林和公共空间之间的过渡。

5 月 9 日

外滩 — 历史建筑沿黄浦江西岸排开，对面是陆家嘴。沿着江边走，在同一个视野里就能比较上海不同时期形成的城市界面。

洛克·外滩源 — 街区在苏州河与黄浦江汇合处。David Chipperfield Architects 参与修缮原亚洲文会大楼等历史建筑，街区里的上海外滩美术馆展示了旧建筑如何继续承载新的公共用途。

北外滩 — 从虹口一侧沿江走，陆家嘴的几座高楼与近处的滨水绿地出现在同一条视线上。这里也提供了一个观察城市岸线如何向步行和停留开放的角度。

5 月 10 日

上海天安1号 — 天安中国将项目二期称为 Shanghai One Tian An Place。这里的住宅组团以街道和住区绿轴串联，塔楼围绕开放空间布置，适合从总图看住宅与街区商业如何接上。

张园 — 南京西路旁的石库门街区保留了里弄尺度、清水砖墙和门楣等细节。今天，展览和商业沿着原有街巷展开，走到门口仍能读到旧民居的尺度。

新天地 — 瑞安将石库门街区引入餐饮、零售和文化活动。与张园放在一起看，可以比较相似的里弄形态如何适应不同的店铺开口、街道停留和公共活动。

5 月 11 日

安澜上海 — 位于徐汇滨江片区的住宅项目。示范区用抬升的平台组织入口和景观，步行层与下方功能之间的高差，是理解园林、建筑和到达动线的线索。

徐汇西岸 — 徐汇滨江的旧工业岸线上逐步长出展览、艺术和滨水步行空间。保留下来的工业设施让新展馆和公共空间仍有具体的历史背景。

5 月 12 日

保利·世博天悦 — 保利的发展披露中称为上海保利世博项目，位于浦东世博滨江。这站的看点是住宅如何面向黄浦江，以及住区内部景观如何衔接过去的世博片区。

金茂璞元 — 项目在虹口瑞虹板块。示范区的台地、流水和乔木把从街道到住区的步行过程分成几段，园林的层次在行走中比单看一张立面更容易理解。

杭州 · 5 月 13–14 日

杭州两天先看住宅，还走访了电梯工厂和天目里。璟逸与安璞各有一套组织空间的办法：一处从不同标高安排回家路径，另一处借陶砖、石材和玻璃处理立面的层次。天目里的中心广场把视角又拉回城市，建筑之间留出的地方同样值得停下来拍。

5 月 13 日

中天海威·璟逸 — 九米设计以局部抬板组织住宅的三个高程。地面水景连廊串起庭院，下沉庭院连接会所，上层也有步行和观景路径。走过同一组建筑，可以在不同标高看到不同的空间关系。

SWORD 电梯工厂 — 西奥电梯将 SWORD 列为旗下海外品牌。工厂是路线里少见的制造现场，也把注意力从住宅样板间转到电梯、交通和建筑交付背后的设备。

5 月 14 日

海威中天·安璞 — goa 大象设计在高层立面上组合铝材、陶砖、石材和大面积玻璃。远看是连贯的横向线条，走近则能看到层间陶砖的进退和阴影。低层排屋改用竖向石材框架，和高层形成不同的街巷尺度。

天目里 — 伦佐·皮亚诺建筑工作室在中国的首个作品。17 栋单体围合出中心广场，水镜、花园和树阵分散在其中，办公、展览与零售通过地面步行空间连在一起。

成都 · 5 月 15–16 日

成都两天的大部分行程围绕麓湖展开。从展厅里的沙盘走到岸边，再从水上回看建筑，社区和湖之间的关系比站在展厅里更清楚。CPI 岛把旧样板间转成可以走进去的商业与文化空间，环水和漩涡两个公园各有自己的岸线。最后一站成都 SKP 把零售放到地表以下，从花园下行又是一种不同的进入方式。

5 月 15 日

麓湖生态城 — 成都天府新区的湖居社区，住宅、公共空间和商业沿湖泊与湿地组织。步行和乘船给出两种观察尺度：岸上看入口、步道和绿地，水面上看几处社区如何沿不同岸线展开。

麓湖 CPI 岛 — 几里建筑将岛上的旧别墅样板间更新为商业和文化空间。原有小体量建筑、树木和岸线被保留下来，新的步行路径把各处重新接在一起。

5 月 16 日

麓湖生态城·沄洲 — Cloud Island 在建筑事务所 10 Design 的中文资料中称为沄洲，是麓湖生态城内的一处住宅综合体。这一站把考察拉回住宅本身，可以与前一天从湖面看到的社区尺度对照。

麓湖环水公园 — 公园位于麓湖南部湖系，湖中有三处离岸岛屿。岛、岸线及其间的水面为装置、观景和散步留出空间，园路跟着水的位置展开。

麓湖漩涡公园 — 张唐景观设计的公园以湖心岛为中心，周边是住宅与商业用地。岛上的星光之环把视线和游线都引向水面，和环水公园的多个小岛形成对照。

成都 SKP — Sybarite 将大部分零售空间置于地面以下，地上保留花园与步行空间。下沉庭院、开口和通道从地表向下引导人流，屋顶公园因而也是建筑的入口。
